# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native portrait mobile Tetris-like falling-block puzzle called **Prism Well: Falling Geometry**. Use a 10×20 grid, seven classic tetrominoes, falling gravity, left/right movement, rotation, soft drop, hard drop, lock-on-collision, full-line clearing, score/lines/level HUD, increasing speed, next-piece preview, ghost landing projection, top-out game over, and restart.

The presentation should feel like a minimalist neon geometry instrument: faceted prism cells, cyan/violet/gold accents, procedural animated blueprint background, compact glass HUD, and touch-friendly buttons at the bottom for left, right, rotate, soft drop, and hard drop. The game must be playable and readable in portrait aspect ratios from roughly 4:7 through 9:16.

# Blueprint — Prism Well Falling Geometry

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is an inline canvas physics merge/drop game with a start screen, HUD, next-piece preview, pointer/touch drop controls, score, merge feedback, a danger line, and game-over state. Its code shows mobile-safe DOM overlays, canvas rendering, WebAudio/remote audio hooks, and touch scoping to the canvas.

## Rebuilt target
The canonical `index.html` is rebuilt as a Tetris-style falling-block puzzle: a 10×20 grid, seven tetromino shapes, falling timer, left/right movement, rotation with small wall kicks, soft drop, hard drop, lock-on-collision, full-row clears, score/lines/level HUD, escalating speed, ghost landing projection, top-out failure, and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Grid-based falling piece loop.
- Piece movement, rotation, collision, locking, line clears, score/level updates, and top-out failure.
- Mobile-first input actionability: buttons and swipe/tap gestures remain reachable.

## Transformable surfaces
- World identity, title, HUD copy, background, cell rendering, feedback particles, typography, color palette, and mobile chrome are presentation surfaces and were transformed into the Prism Well identity.

identity.title: Prism Well: Falling Geometry
identity.prompt: Tetris falling-block puzzle optimized for portrait mobile play, elegant spatial logic, escalating speed, perfect-fit satisfaction, minimalist tension, endless optimization, and iconic geometric rhythm.
identity.identity: A luminous portrait-format geometry well where faceted prism tetrominoes descend into a harmonic grid.
identity.player_role: Spatial optimizer guiding falling prism pieces into clean rows before the well overflows.
identity.core_loop: Spawn tetromino, move and rotate, soft or hard drop, lock, clear full rows, score, level up, repeat until top-out.
